purpose: Reviewer-requested clinical manuscript strengthening for BMC Pharmacology and Toxicology

development_context.trigger: Structured BMC Pharmacology and Toxicology peer-review simulation requested revisions
development_context.classification: post-result exploratory sensitivity and descriptive extension
source_inspection_before_freeze: The frozen primary cohort size, main result, baseline imbalance and existing weight summaries were already known.
Before this plan was written, aggregate source inspection identified the initiation data sources and preliminary 14-day administration-day and switch counts.
No route-restricted outcome estimate or alternative missing-data estimate had been calculated.

frozen_primary.endpoint: hospital documented confirmed recovery by day 14 with death and live discharge as competing first events
frozen_primary.analysis: Firth propensity-score overlap weighting with 2000 patient-cluster bootstrap refits

diagnostics.propensity: Arm-specific propensity-score quantiles and kernel-density curves
diagnostics.weights: Arm-specific overlap-weight quantiles, ESS and distributions
diagnostics.balance: All fitted-term before/after absolute SMD Love plot

treatment_context.initiation_route: Parenteral if any ICU input record occurs at t0 or an eMAR administration at t0 has audited IV route; enteral if all observed t0 routes are PO/NG/oral; otherwise unknown
treatment_context.window: from t0 through the earliest of t0 plus 14 days, hospital discharge, or recorded death
treatment_context.interpretation: descriptive exposure trajectory, not an as-treated causal analysis

parenteral_route_sensitivity.population: primary cohort after excluding linezolid initiations classified as enteral or unknown; all vancomycin initiations retained
parenteral_route_sensitivity.model: same baseline propensity specification as the frozen primary model, with deterministic removal of constant or aliased columns
parenteral_route_sensitivity.promotion_rule: report regardless of direction; do not promote as a new primary analysis

missing_data_sensitivity.predictors: all other frozen baseline covariates, treatment, hospital first-event status and log1p observed first-event time
missing_data_sensitivity.propensity_model: frozen main-effects specification with imputed continuous values and without missing-indicator terms
missing_data_sensitivity.pooling: Rubin rules using within-imputation patient-bootstrap variance and between-imputation variance
missing_data_sensitivity.promotion_rule: report regardless of direction as an exploratory sensitivity analysis

observation_process.interpretation: descriptive only; does not remove informative monitoring

transcriptomics.submission_supplement: remove detailed disease-context tables and retain one transparent sentence that prior exploratory analyses were null and not treatment-mechanism validation
transcriptomics.repository: retain historical reproducibility materials with an explicit statement that they are outside the revised clinical manuscript

privacy.public_small_cells: integer cells from 1 through 9 and linked/complementary values suppressed

manuscript_claim_boundary: Association between initial observed treatment and documented in-hospital confirmation; no causal treatment recommendation, sustained-exposure effect, biological recovery effect, or molecular mechanism claim.
